attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, with strict identity preservation.
Asset: a restrained monochrome line drawing for a Chinese narrative game. This is a local correction of an existing sketch, not a new composition and not a color rendering.

INPUT ROLES
Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET: Chen Ping'an alone on a timber gallery after rain, looking into his raised palm. Preserve this image's framing and content.
Image 2 is the face identity reference only. Image 3 is the clothing construction reference only. Keep the edit target's already-correct curled hairpin, no backpack or shoulder straps, and its one small waist gourd with a short cord; do not import the references' old plain hairpin or backpack.

CHANGE ONLY THESE TWO AREAS
1. Make the WATER IN THE PALM clearly legible at normal full-image viewing size. Keep the raised hand in the same location, its arm and gaze unchanged. Very slightly cup the palm and naturally curl the fingers enough to contain a tiny amount of rainwater. Draw a small, irregular shallow water-film outline lying directly ON the skin in the center of the palm, with a restrained inner reflection line and one tiny droplet at the fingertip edge. It must visibly read as a little real water gathered from the wet railing. No floating orb, magic, glow, sphere, jewel, large splash, pouring stream, or object held in the hand. Keep five anatomically coherent fingers, a natural wrist, and thin dark-gray line work. The water should be readable but remain a subtle story detail.
2. Correct the HEIGHT OF THE WOODEN GUARDRAIL as a coherent architectural structure. The current top rail beside him reads too low, near his upper thigh. Keep the camera, floor, character height and feet, gallery footprint, timber columns and landscape fixed. Raise the rail's top edge at his own depth to his lower abdomen/waist region, approximately the level just below his waist belt, safely BELOW his raised hand. In the original 941-pixel-high target this is roughly y=390-420 beside him, not the present thigh-level line near y=500. Treat these as visual guides, not rigid measurement labels. Adjust the adjoining post tops, horizontal rails, intermediate panels and the receding section together while keeping their bases anchored to the same gallery floor. Use one consistent perspective and continuous joins, including the foreground railing on the right. Do not merely enlarge or move one foreground beam. Do not raise the rail to his chest or hide his palm, face, waist gourd, or feet. The character remains fully inside the gallery, on its floor.

PRESERVE
Keep exactly the same wide approximately 16:9 composition, camera position, full-body framing, man's left-third placement, face, age, hair, downward gaze, shoulder position, relaxed lowered other arm, foot positions, clothing silhouette, main waist rope and long tassels, single gourd and short attachment. Preserve the door wall, roof, pillars, lantern positions, river, bridge, far buildings and mountains in their existing locations. No new objects or people, no extra roof or extra floor, no camera tilt, no crop or zoom. The higher rail naturally changes only its local occlusion of the existing distant view.

STYLE AND OUTPUT
Keep the current clean black/gray line-art stage on a near-white background, sparse existing light gray washes only. Do not add color, dramatic lighting, dense shading, woodgrain, tiny costume decoration, lettering, arrows or labels. The story occurs after rain at night, but night color treatment is deliberately deferred. Produce one corrected full-frame sketch. Project target is 1920x1080 landscape; preserve this target image's composition and aspect ratio, and do not stretch the character.

attempts.prompt:
Precise local architectural edit of the supplied image. Keep this exact composition and monochrome sketch; change ONLY the height of the wooden gallery guardrail.

The railing directly beside the man's raised forearm is still too low. Make a substantial, clearly visible correction: raise the TOP OF THE HANDRAIL BESIDE THE MAN by about 90–100 pixels in this 1672x941 image. At the rail's left endpoint immediately right of his body (around x=690), move its upper edge from approximately y=460 to y=365–380. It should align with his waist belt / lower abdomen, not the hip or upper thigh. Do not merely raise the cap of a post; the actual horizontal handrail must be at this new height.

Extend the vertical posts UPWARD from their existing fixed floor contacts. Rebuild the attached upper rails, vertical infill and middle/lower members coherently. Adjust the neighboring foreground and receding spans to one continuous, credible perspective, so the height is consistent along the gallery. Keep the exact floor footprint and corridor width. The handrail must remain below the raised palm, without hiding the hand, face, gourd or feet. This is a taller railing, not a translated railing floating above the floor, not a thicker beam, and not a shorter man.

Everything else is locked: same camera, crop and full-body framing; character position, body proportions, face, hair, curled hairpin, both hands, already-visible water in his palm, clothes, single waist gourd, ropes, legs and feet; wall, columns, ceiling, lanterns, river, bridge and mountains. Preserve these visually as closely as possible. Do not add objects or redesign architecture outside the railing. The railing's local occlusion of the existing view may change naturally.

Output one full-frame corrected line drawing. No color, new shading, text, labels, arrows, alternate views, zoom or crop. Preserve the input aspect ratio and the project's landscape 1920x1080 intent without stretching anything.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render, identity-preserving COLORIZATION of the first image. Produce one finished 2D narrative illustration from this exact approved line drawing. Do not redesign or recompose it.

INPUT ROLES
1. EDIT TARGET: the final corrected line drawing. It controls every pose, object, position, silhouette, railing height, camera and framing.
2. Face mother reference: the same Chen Ping'an, a calm 20–22-year-old with a slender tapered face and natural narrow eyes. Use identity and natural skin/hair colors only, not its old plain round-headed hairpin.
3. Outfit mother reference: use intrinsic garment colors and construction only. Do not import its backpack, shoulder straps, hat, extra sandals or standing pose.
4. Gourd reference: only the small gourd's muted vermilion body and gold scroll decoration. Do not import the photographed hand or glossy 3D material.
5. Existing approved chapter artwork: use its restrained 2D line-and-color rendering and coherent warm lantern / cool night color language only. Do not copy its people, interior, camera, furniture or bright indoor illumination.

SCENE AND LIGHT
Deep night immediately AFTER rain has stopped, alone on a fourth-floor riverside timber gallery. Quiet, reflective, intimate. Color the existing sky and distant layered mountains in subdued dark blue-gray, with atmospheric separation; the river is a muted cool slate blue with restrained broken reflections. It must clearly be night, not dusk, dawn, a bright white sky or daylight. Retain the existing river, bridge and far-building outlines; let them recede softly into night, with only sparse dim window light. Add no moon, stars, storm, active rain or new objects.
The existing hanging lanterns give localized soft amber light onto nearby beams, the man and wet floor. Preserve readable facial features, the gaze into his hand and the small water film. Warm light should touch skin, cloth and the rail naturally without turning the whole image orange. Keep cool ambient shadows from outside. Wet dark-brown timber and rail tops have a few soft reflections, not chrome shine. His palm holds a little real rainwater: maintain the existing water shape, a tiny pale reflected glint and delicate fingertip droplet, never a glowing orb or magical effect.

LOCKED INTRINSIC COLORS
His outer short-sleeved robe is muted GRAY-BLUE, inner long-sleeved garment OFF-WHITE / PALE GRAY, trousers and forearm/calf wraps CHARCOAL GRAY. Hair is black; the target's slender curled jade hairpin is muted green. Straw sandals are natural faded straw brown. Main waist rope, knot, ALL long hanging cords and tassels remain GRAY-BROWN HEMP: preserve their length and form, do not turn them red. Only the single small gourd and its SHORT waist-to-neck attachment cord are red; the gourd has restrained gold scroll motifs. No extra bag, gourd or ornaments. Let local lighting affect values while keeping each material's identity legible.

PRESERVE STRUCTURE
Same wide full-body crop, same figure placement, exact head angle and expression, shoulder/elbow/wrist shapes, raised cupped palm and already-visible water, lowered other hand, two grounded feet, garment silhouette, waist attachments and curled hairpin. Preserve the CORRECTED rail height at the lower abdomen, its post bases, continuous upper rail and connected crossbars. Keep all wall/roof/column/lantern, river/bridge/mountain positions. No changes to perspective, no lowered railing, no extra finger, no new gesture, no zoom or crop. Natural light and color are the changes.

RENDERING
Fine controlled deep-gray contours, broad matte low-saturation color shapes and a few coherent soft shadows, subtle paper softness rather than conspicuous grain. Keep costume folds simple and background detail subordinate. No dense cloth pattern, noisy woodgrain, heavy embossed-paper relief, photorealism, glossy 3D, neon cyan or epic fantasy effects. Match the restrained project illustration style. No text, watermark, panels or UI. Landscape 16:9, project target1920x1080; preserve the source composition and proportions without stretching.

Precise LOCAL correction to the supplied finished color image. The rain has completely stopped. There is residual WATER ON SURFACES, but NO falling rain or airborne water droplets.

Remove only the small suspended pale droplets and short vertical rain-like streaks above and below the man's raised palm, against the wooden column. On the original 1672x941 canvas, the two small areas are approximately x690–702, y263–286 above the hand, and x693–703, y318–366 below the hand. Reconstruct the matching brown wood and existing local light behind those marks. Remove any other isolated airborne rain streak immediately around this hand. Do not turn ordinary woodgrain into a flat patch.

PRESERVE the shallow water film resting INSIDE his palm, skin outline, every finger, pose and downward gaze. Keep the moisture beads ATTACHED to the railing, wet-floor reflections, and distant river reflections. Water lying on his palm is still visible; nothing is falling into it or falling out of it.

Lock all other content and rendering: identical face, hair and green curled hairpin, gray-blue robe, off-white inner shirt, gray-brown long waist ropes, single red-gold gourd with its short red cord, feet, corrected waist-level railing, camera, crop, composition, warm lantern light, cool dark night sky and mountains. Do not repaint or brighten the scene, add rain, add people, alter materials, or change the illustration style. One full-frame color image, same aspect ratio; no labels or text.
